description: Four-step sequencer clocked from step to step, working over the 0-10V range that CV uses rather than the bipolar range a note sequencer covers

params.text: Sets the voltage of that step in whole volts, 0 to 10V

inputs.text: Added to the knob of that step, the sum clamped to 0-10V
Advances to the next of the four steps on each rising edge through 1.7V

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequencer has reached, held until the next clock edge

notes: Nothing leaves the module until a clock reaches CLK: the output holds 0V until the first rising edge through 1.7V, and each edge reads that step once and holds the result until the next edge.
